reviewObjects.name: Целостность Telegram и дозапись крупных файлов
reviewObjects.content: 40 MiB normal/premium uploads, 128 seeded byte ranges, out-of-order responses and OPFS short writes pass. Valid partial writes finish byte-exactly; zero/invalid writes reject finitely and remove unfinished output. No false 100% after failed writes.
reviewObjects.confirmationAction: Принять проверенное изменение исходников и результаты тестов; отправка сообщений не запускается.

reviewObjects.name: Отмена, повторы и независимые запросы
reviewObjects.content: 1000 queued MTProto parts are canceled without retained media states. A sibling Ping in the same sent container remains resolvable; late replies do not resurrect canceled media. 100 mixed save/preview operations are serialized; 200 canceled queued saves do not enter native IPC.
reviewObjects.confirmationAction: Принять результаты сценарных тестов; аккаунты и настройки не меняются.

reviewObjects.name: Потоковые оригиналы и Full HD без потери байтов
reviewObjects.content: 70 MiB synthetic originals stream byte-exactly with one GET over verified HTTP/1.1 and h2. An actual local H264 1920x1080 MP4 of 1210 seconds passes real bundled ffprobe and retains SHA256 through file output. CDN/engine download speed is not inferred from localhost fixtures.
reviewObjects.confirmationAction: Принять проверку файлового канала; это не подтверждение всех CDN или аккаунтов.

reviewObjects.name: Точные сообщения об ошибках диска
reviewObjects.content: Original CDN declared size and resolver file size above the dynamic free-disk budget produce MEDIA_DISK_FULL; buffered preview remains MEDIA_TOO_LARGE. Three original-mode regression cases fail before the patch and pass afterward; malformed length remains rejected without output.
reviewObjects.confirmationAction: Принять исправление классификации ошибки; лимиты сервисов и сетевые настройки не меняются.

reproducedFixedDefects.symptom: A valid short sync-access write returned a partial byte count; it was ignored and damaged output could resolve as complete.
reproducedFixedDefects.fix: Write remaining subarray at offset+writtenTotal until complete; reject noninteger/zero/negative/oversized write counts; existing failure cleanup stays active.

reproducedFixedDefects.symptom: An original exceeding the free-disk-derived budget produced the preview-size warning instead of the disk-space warning.
reproducedFixedDefects.fix: Valid over-budget originals use MEDIA_DISK_FULL; buffered mode keeps MEDIA_TOO_LARGE; malformed length remains rejected.

oneByteOpfsFixture.warning: Mock storage calls and test overhead are included; this is not a real disk IOPS or network benchmark. Positive writes are finite; actual synchronous disk calls can occupy the GramJS worker until a single part is fully written.

limitations: No user messages, uploads to real chats, posts, likes, follows or account-setting mutations were performed. Real service-account and CDN pilots are owned by parent.

OPFS handles and Telegram clients are synthetic boundaries around actual imported production JS. The actual local 1210 s Full HD MP4 is generated at 1 frame per 10 seconds, black, without audio; it validates resolution/duration/file integrity rather than playback perception or audio quality.

The 70 MiB stream is synthetic JPEG-prefixed bytes, not a decodable image. RSS sampling includes the test HTTPS server, TLS and client; localhost speed must not be used as provider/ISP speed evidence.

Preview 64MiB and selected share bounds, account/server file limits, FLOOD_WAIT, finite retry/timeout, dynamic disk budget and provider availability are preserved. Tests do not promise arbitrary restricted/private/DRM/live material.
The full test tsconfig still has 55 other-file diagnostics. Native WebView, all actual screens and real platform delivery are separate aggregate gates.
